title: Prince Hans-Adam expects Jesus on a flying saucer
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Prince Hans-Adam expects Jesus on a flying saucer, about present at Liechtenstein, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The royal prince of Liechtenstein, Hans-Adam. He believes Jesus will show up on a flying saucer.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Hans-Adam, the reigning prince of Liechtenstein, a small country in Europe, believes Jesus will arrive on a flying saucer. Michels mentions it as part of a wider talk about secret groups and a coming final event.
